description: Java class UomWorker providing utility methods for unit of measure conversions and time calculations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UomWorker
classes.description: Final utility class for unit of measure and time operations.

methods.name: uomTimeToCalTime
methods.description: Converts a UOM ID to corresponding Calendar field and multiplier.

methods.name: addUomTime
methods.description: Adds a specified UOM time value to a Calendar object, optionally starting from a given Timestamp.

methods.name: convertUom
methods.description: Converts a value from one UOM to another using the 'convertUom' service.
